selection_side: side with larger calibrated market-only EV at the entry quote

A.description: The audited frozen policy. Paper-staked at Kelly sizing; the only tier eligible for a future real-money decision.

B.description: Pre-registered expansion cohort (paper only, flat 1u). Also catches audited-policy bets that drift below A gates under live features (93.8 percent decision parity, conservative direction).

execution.rule: minimum acceptable decimal price = 1.02 / p_market. Bet only at or above it. Below it: pass. No chasing, no rescoring on price moves, no rebets.
counts_prospective_rules: discovery_lag_h <= 168 (line first seen within 7 days of scoring)

sizing.kelly_price_basis: best executable price when actionable, else minimum acceptable price
sizing.event_allocation: A-tier only: remaining-budget per event (per_event_cap minus already-staked A bets); simultaneous batch over budget scales proportionally (backtest rule); placed stakes never resize
sizing.note: amendment 2026-08-05a: mechanics specified, fractions unchanged; B-tier flat unit outside the event cap (paper only)

cohorts: tier x side (favorite/underdog) tracked separately; dogs are IN per user decision 2026-08-05, small-sample caveat pre-registered
primary metric: realized CLV vs Pinnacle close; secondary: CLV vs retail consensus close; ROI monitored, not gating
rules: hold to settlement; no exits, hedges, or rebets
one signal per pair per event, scored at first sighting with known start time
model features use the frozen open; EV gate and min price use the entry quote
no retuning of model, gates, or sizing during the run; scheduled refit restarts nothing if gates unchanged (see PREREG)
